obfuscation_indicators: maintain flexibility and meet cost expectations
did not meet fixed charge coverage ratio
risk_summary: The disclosure is heavily quantified and explains major year-over-year drivers, but presents material risks from global tobacco oversupply, declining volumes and sales, restructuring dependence, high debt, and an effective tax rate distorted by losses. Liquidity is described as sufficient, yet the company failed to meet a fixed-charge coverage requirement for restricted payments, signaling covenant pressure. The outlook relies on market rebalancing, execution of restructuring savings, and continued access to funding sources.
